title: world.slots.offer
description: The world's slot map as the server publishes it, by content hash and wire size only (MG9 G2G): on join after the regions' index offers and whenever a build publishes, and only when the published indices name it. The client takes it from its own cache by hash, or asks for it with world.slots.get; the world.slots parts that answer carry it deflated.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the slot map's canonical JSON text (the map's own hash).

chars.description: Its wire form's length: the world.slots parts' text, all together.
